process_input_messages: apply guardrails to A2A JSON-RPC input messages by extracting and filtering text from message parts
process_output_response: apply guardrails to A2A JSON-RPC output responses by extracting text from message, artifact, or status parts
process_output_streaming_response: apply guardrails to accumulated A2A streaming chunks by concatenating, filtering, and redistributing text
parse_streaming_responses: parse a list of A2A streaming responses into JSON objects and filter entries with valid result dicts
extract_texts_from_result: extract text content from all possible A2A result locations including parts, artifacts, and status messages
